reason: I have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp for ten years, and I cannot trust a setup where an assistant might accidentally move or delete our Google Drive folders. With a mid-sized team and rotating clerks, the risk of accidental deletions or misplaced client archives is too great to risk our operations on new software.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Enforced folder-lock permissions that make client structures in Google Drive undeletable and immovable by assistants, plus safeguards preventing clerks from downloading client files to personal laptops.
